coder_result.remark: Template registry and delivery templates have critical structural misalignments with SOP: registry omits validation phase; status field values in Review/Validation/Task templates don't match SOP state machine; artifact ID formats don't follow naming discipline; folder paths inconsistent. Required to fix 5 CRITICAL and 3 HIGH severity issues before approval.

findings.impact: Registry lists only 7 artifacts (missing 05_validation). Flow diagram shows incorrect phase sequence. Validation phase (mandatory per SOP) is completely absent from template index and workflow flow. This prevents proper artifact generation and runner state machine enforcement.

findings.issue: Task Graph template Doc Type mismatch
findings.impact: Lists 'Doc Type: 02_plan_artifact' but per SOP naming discipline should be '02b_task_graph'. Will cause sidecar validation failures and artifact path/ID mismatches.
Uses 'VALIDATION-{{YYYYMMDD}}-{{NN}}' but SOP specifies 'VAL-{{YYYYMMDD}}-{{NN}}'. Non-conforming IDs will fail runner validation.

findings.issue: Review template status values misaligned with SOP state machine
findings.impact: Lists status as 'in_progress | approved | rejected' but SOP specifies 'Draft → Final' lifecycle. Status field should never contain decision values (APPROVED/REJECTED); those belong in decision field. Runner will reject non-conforming status values.

Lists status as 'VALIDATION_IN_PROGRESS / VALIDATED / FAILED / Superseded' but SOP requires standard lifecycle 'Draft → Final' with decision field for APPROVED/REJECTED. Non-conforming values prevent runner state machine enforcement.

findings.issue: Task template status options include non-existent states
findings.impact: Lists 'pending | in_progress | in_review | approved | rejected | completed' but SOP specifies 'Pending → In Progress → Implemented → Approved'. Incorrect states will cause sidecar validation failures.

Template references '04_implementation_plans/' (plural) in some places but SOP specifies '04_implementation/' (singular). Inconsistent naming causes artifact path mismatches and prevents runner from locating sidecars.

findings.issue: Review template missing documentation of review scope
findings.impact: Related Doc Type options incomplete; doesn't clarify that reviews can cover any artifact type. Missing guidance on what artifacts get reviewed in delivery workflow.

findings.issue: Implementation Plan metadata uses wrong ID type
findings.impact: Lists 'Plan ID' for implementation plan artifact; should be 'IMPL-' prefix per SOP. Misleading metadata.

evidence.notes: Registry lists 7 artifacts; missing 05_validation. Flow diagram incomplete.
Section 'Naming and Folder Discipline' specifies VAL-YYYYMMDD-NN format for validation, IMPL-YYYYMMDD-NN for implementation plan, MEMORY-YYYYMMDD-NN for memory. Templates use non-conforming formats.

Section 'Artifact Lifecycle Rules' specifies allowed state transitions. Review: Draft → Final. Validation: Draft → Final. Task: Pending → In Progress → Implemented → Approved. Templates use non-conforming status values.
Section 'Folder Structure' specifies 04_implementation/ (singular). Templates and registry reference 04_implementation_plans/ (plural).
